quote.text: Vain trifles as they seem, clothes have, they say, more important offices than merely to keep us warm. They change our view of the world and the world’s view of us.
quote.author: Virginia Woolf, Orlando: A Biography (Hogarth Press, 1928), chapter four

stories.headline: Aero cuts its horsehide Highwayman to order in Galashiels
stories.dek: Himel Bros charges US$2,950 for a bespoke Shinki-horsehide Canuck; Schott’s 618 Perfecto costs US$1,020, and Saint Laurent’s lambskin biker US$5,600.

stories.headline: Singapore Airlines adds Amsterdam flights under Schiphol’s new cap
stories.dek: Three A350 flights a week join the daily 777 from 15 February to 26 March 2027; the Dutch decree in force since 1 November holds Schiphol to 478,000 flights a year.

stories.kicker: The Diary · Final Fantasy, Chingay And Comic Con
stories.headline: Tokyo National Museum stages Final Fantasy’s 40th-anniversary exhibition
stories.dek: Children pay ¥1,100 when it opens in Ueno on 8 January; Singapore’s Chingay parade, 19–20 February, goes on sale on 2 December.

stories.headline: Brussels summit ends without EU budget or Ukraine loan
stories.dek: Czechia, Hungary and Slovakia still refuse the €45 billion loan for 2027; António Costa will try again on 17 December.

stories.kicker: Singapore · The Cost Of A Farewell
stories.headline: NEA raises Singapore’s cremation fee for the first time since 1997
stories.dek: From 1 January a citizen’s cremation at Mandai costs S$175, up from S$100; the fee to scatter ashes on land falls to S$200.

stories.headline: Chinese chip stocks post record day on Beijing pledge
stories.dek: An index of 40 chipmakers jumped 17.6 per cent on Friday 27 November after Premier Li Qiang’s cabinet told the state-backed “national team” to steady the market.

stories.kicker: The Kit · Garmin Fenix 9 Black Friday Cut
stories.headline: Garmin cuts its new Fenix 9 by US$100
stories.dek: The first Garmin-approved sale on a just-launched Fenix began on 23 November, 88 days after launch; Garmin’s Singapore store still asks S$1,489 for the 47mm Pro.

stories.kicker: The Good Life · Piaget Andy Warhol ‘Camouflage’
stories.headline: Piaget sets Warhol’s camouflage in stone and gold
stories.dek: SJX’s hands-on of 25 November priced the 86-piece white-gold watch at S$122,000 before tax; its dial is 27 cut pieces of sodalite, turquoise and gold.

stories.headline: Focker-In-Law overtakes Disney’s Hexed on Thanksgiving Day
stories.dek: Disney’s US$200 million Hexed took US$4.5 million on 26 November; Deadline now expects about US$35 million over the five-day holiday.

stories.kicker: Raising Them Well · Puberty, Hormones And Mood
stories.headline: University of Melbourne finds girls’ hormone swings no warning sign
stories.dek: Muskan Khetan’s team tested the saliva of 145 Australian girls aged 11 to 17 every week for five weeks; bigger swings went with slightly calmer moods, not worse ones, she wrote on 27 November.

stories.kicker: The Macro Desk · The Thanksgiving Rebound
stories.headline: S&P 500 recovers 5.6% as Treasury yields climb
stories.dek: Friday’s half-day added 1.6 per cent to 7,297, while the BEA’s revision of third-quarter growth to 4.3 per cent lifted the ten-year yield to 4.94.

stories.kicker: The Invitation · Kintsugi, Japan’s Gold Repair
stories.headline: Tsugu Tsugu opens Kyoto kintsugi studio in 70-year-old house
stories.dek: The Tokyo repair firm’s third studio opened in Higashiyama on 1 November, charging ¥22,000 for a 90-minute class; its Tokyo studios quote at least three months for a full repair.

stories.headline: Fast, light lifts build hip bone in Loughborough trial
stories.dek: Ogulcan Caliskan’s team trained 109 women aged 50 to 70 for eight months, reporting in Bone on 15 November; slow, heavy lifting left the hip unchanged.

stories.kicker: The Undercurrent · Thailand: Chud Thai Goes To UNESCO
stories.headline: Thailand takes Chud Thai, its national dress, to UNESCO
stories.dek: A committee in Xiamen judges the bid on 2 December with Cambodia, which fought Thailand on their border twice in 2025, at the table, and its own Khmer wedding bid due that afternoon.
